notes: Direct/base versions below are pinned from the versions resolved in successful CI run 31884357245 on 2026-08-15 unless otherwise stated.
This file is a planning/review inventory, not a declaration of complete license compliance.
A release build must generate a complete resolved package inventory and collect actual wheel/binary license files before Stage 11D can complete.
The frontend currently lacks package-lock.json; frontend dependency reproducibility remains a Stage 11D blocker.
